summary: Frontend-only testing of the three new features (Day View, Alert Groups, Clinician Profile / MyDoctorCard) plus requested regressions. All core acceptance criteria met. Two minor UX/data gaps worth flagging: (1) intake·info alert group does not display patient names (patients array is empty in payload) even though warning groups do; the requirement says the group should also list up to 3 names. (2) /api/doctors returns non-doctor entries in the patient dropdown (e.g. 'omar' the patient, 'Dr. Admin', 'Dr Applicant'), which polluted the MyDoctorCard select. Everything else — day-view layout, badges, expand/collapse, styling (sage vs terracotta label), clinician profile persistence, absence of health sections for doctors, presence of health sections for patients, chosen-doctor-details, /doctor/patients list, encounter page intake+screening — worked as specified.

minor.issue: Returns non-doctor users. Patient's my-doctor-select shows 'Dr. Admin', 'omar' (a patient), and 'Dr Applicant' alongside Dr. Layla Haddad. Should be filtered to approved clinicians only.
intake·info group returns no patient names in `patients` array (rendered row shows only count and 'latest <date>'). Spec asked for up to 3 names + '+N more' for every group.

issues: Warning-severity group container uses neutral 'border-line' background; only the small type·severity label is text-terracotta. Review request implied warning/critical groups themselves should be styled terracotta (like the info group is styled sage). Only 'critical' severity actually gets terracotta container styling in AlertGroups.jsx (lines 26-28).

action_items: Filter /api/doctors to only approved clinicians (exclude admin, patients, pending applicants) so MyDoctorCard dropdown is clean.
Populate `patients` list for intake·info alert group in /api/doctor/dashboard so the rolled-up row can show '<name>, <name> +N more' like the warning groups do.
Consider extending terracotta container styling in AlertGroups.jsx to `warning` severity, not just `critical`, to match the review's phrasing (warning/critical = terracotta).
critical_code_review_comments: AlertGroups.jsx: severity styling branch only distinguishes 'critical' vs 'info'; 'warning' falls through to neutral border. If PM wants a 3-tier visual signal this needs an extra branch.
MyDoctorCard.jsx: no client-side filter guards against non-doctor rows returned by /api/doctors; backend must be the source of truth here.
ClinicianProfileCard.jsx: reads user.specialty/clinic/city/bio directly from useAuth without a fetch fallback — works because /api/profile/clinician returns the full user, good; just noting.
test_credentials: Used dr.layla@sihha.ai / Doctor@123 and omar.patient@sihha.ai / Patient@123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No throwaway accounts created.

rca of the issue: Intake·info empty patients list is likely because the backend aggregator groups intake completions without denormalizing patient_name into the group (unlike medication/vital alerts which already carry patient_name). /api/doctors filter appears to select any user with a name starting with 'Dr' or role != patient; needs a stricter role='doctor' AND is_approved filter.
